<table class="forumlist darkbackground1" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0; border-collapse: collapse; overflow: hidden">
	<tr class="forumlist-header">
		{{#if:{{{created|}}}|<th class="forum_date">Created</th>}}
		<th class="forum_title">{{#if:{{{2|}}}|Pinned topic|Topic}}</th>
		{{#if:{{{author|}}}|<th class="forum_author">Created by</th>}}
		<th class="forum_edited">Last edit</th>
		<th class="forum_editor">Last author</th>
	</tr>{{{1}}}{{#if:{{{2|}}}|
	<tr class="forumlist-header">
		{{#if:{{{created|}}}|<th class="forum_date">Created</th>}}
		<th class="forum_title">Topic</th>
		{{#if:{{{author|}}}|<th class="forum_author">Created by</th>}}
		<th class="forum_edited">Last edit</th>
		<th class="forum_editor">Last author</th>
	</tr>
	{{{2}}}|}}
</table><noinclude>

[[Category:Utility templates|{{PAGENAME}}]]

</noinclude>
